title: Saltbush Auto Repair
brief: We're Saltbush Auto Repair, a family-run five-bay independent shop in Tucson, Arizona. Word of mouth has always been our best advertising, but people searching "mechanic near me" never find us, and a lot of them think we cost more than the dealer. We don't. Services: brakes, check-engine diagnostics, AC repair (it's Tucson), cooling systems, oil service, hybrid service for Toyota and Lexus, and fleet accounts for local businesses. Phone (520) 555-0187, 1840 W. Saltbush Road, Tucson, AZ 85705. Hours: Monday to Friday 7:30am–5:30pm, Saturday 8am–1pm. Our warranty: 24 months or 24,000 miles on parts and labor for most repairs. The diagnostic fee is to confirm and is credited to the repair if you go ahead. Visitors should be able to call or request an appointment from a phone in one tap. The request form isn't linked to our shop software yet, so it can't confirm a booking. Don't write anything about manufacturer warranties, and no made-up reviews or star ratings.
